Class Vector3f

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.panel.Vector3f
public class Vector3f extends Object
A minimal, mutable single-precision 3D vector with the handful of operations (length, dot, cross, normalize, midpoint) that the mdi3D geometry helpers need. Not related to any JOGL/JOML vector type.
